description: Rules that JSON Schema cannot express. Each producer checks its own output before emitting; the Orchestrator re-runs the cross-contract rules before calling the Judge. kind 'invalid' = contract violation (stop with an error_response). kind 'incomplete' = well-formed but evidence is missing (the Judge returns 'inconclusive').
ref_resolution: Schemas reference each other by $id (autosoc://contracts/...), which is not a fetchable URL. A validator must be given a registry built from every *.schema.json under 00_shared_contracts/, keyed by $id.

rules.rule: coverage.complete is true only if len(labels) == coverage.total_events
compiled_rule.sha256 equals the SHA-256 (UTF-8, hex) of compiled_rule.text
baseline input has role 'baseline' and candidate input has role 'candidate'
task_id and detection_id agree across the two match sets; dataset_id, dataset_version, evaluation_set_id (and evaluation_set_checksum when present) agree across both match sets and the label set
baseline rule_version == base_rule_version; candidate rule_version == candidate_rule_version; candidate_ref == candidate_id; detection_id and task_id agree
every matched event_id (baseline or candidate) has a label
coverage.complete is true and no label has review.status 'disputed' or 'unreviewed'
